providers.name: CloudFero waw3-1
providers.price_basis: Excluding VAT; pay-per-use billed hourly; monthly, half-year and annual fixed commitments
providers.verdict: Corrected from the official price table: the figures are EUR, not PLN. vm.a6000.1 costs €0.51/hour or €349.44/month for 6GB vGPU; suitable for Bielik Q4 only with tight KV headroom. Gemma 4 12B 8-bit needs the 24GB vm.a6000.4 (€2.03/hour; €822.22/month on annual commitment) for practical context headroom. 2 vCPU x86 prefill is a bottleneck.

providers.verdict: Real prices, Warsaw region available, but 7-20x CloudFero's vm.a6000.1 for comparable VRAM

conclusion: Poland sweep final: CloudFero waw3-1 only real winner (vm.a6000.1 ~EUR 0.12/h public). UpCloud Warsaw = real but premium. Artnet/Polcom/COIG/Hostiko quote-only. Order: macstudio POC -> CloudFero vm.a6000.1 -> Gcore L40S -> UpCloud L4.
